reviews.text:
A restaurant specializing in samgyetang
Located an 8-minute walk from Exit 2 of Anguk Station.
Local samgyetang costs 19,000 won.

Garlic pickles!
This is a place where people often order basic samgyetang and perilla seed samgyetang.
I don't like the thick style of samgyetang, so I tried the basic version.
Famous samgyetang restaurants commonly use small chickens, and people are busy looking for lean meat.
Strangely, my fingers seem to hurt after eating samgyetang.
I think I would have to eat 5 to be full of meat.
The lean meat has a slightly strong texture and has a nice texture.
If it's meat, it needs to have this texture to feel good about eating it.
If you eat it with salt, it tastes pretty good.
The soup has a slight ginseng scent, so it feels like eating samgyetang.
You can satisfy your hunger by eating glutinous rice and soup together.
As expected, this taste is like eating samgyetang.
Side dishes include kimchi, radish radish, and pickled garlic. The pickled garlic is delicious.
The spicy, savory flavor seems to go well with samgyetang.
Kimchi and kkakdugi taste like geotjeori (off-cut pancakes).

Store & Tips & Review
The store is large and consists of the first and second floors.
I didn't see a table for two, but eating alone is fine.
When I visited at 7:10 pm on a weekday, the atmosphere was quiet.
There were only two foreign teams, and it was almost like a deadline.
The kitchen closes around 7:30, so visit around 7:00.
You can write down a waiting list at the entrance, and separate waiting seats are provided next to it.
Order at the table and pay at the counter when you leave.
It sells 5 types of samgyetang and fried chicken.
The store is clean and attention is paid to the exterior decoration, so I think foreigners will like it.

Since fall was at its peak, I went for a walk to Samcheong-dong after seeing the fall foliage at Gyeongbokgung Palace.
The yellow scenery was so pretty, and after walking through a quiet alley, I stopped at Eunseol Seolleongtang for lunch.

A traditional seolleongtang restaurant that has been in operation for two generations in Bukchon and Samcheong-dong.
This is a safe restaurant selected by the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs, so you can eat hygienically and safely.
We hand-select all the ingredients and use Korean beef brisket and pork belly of 1, +1, and PL grades, making the soup rich and delicious. I like clear soup, but the seasoning wasn't too strong, so it suited my taste better.
I ordered Korean beef silver sugar and Korean beef snow noodle soup.
It was my first time trying Seolleongtang (Seolleongtang soup), and it was unique and delicious because the noodles were mixed in a rich and clean Seolleongtang soup. If you like noodles, give it a try. I saw the fall foliage and took good care of myself.

There were many foreign customers in the quiet Hanok building, so the atmosphere itself felt like a travel destination. Recommended for those looking for a warm meal in Samcheong-dong :)

This place, famous as a restaurant in Bukchon Hanok Village, specializes in clear and refreshing Seoul-style seolleongtang.
The two menu items I ate were Silver Seolleongtang (30,000 won) and Korean Beef Seolguksutang (17,000 won).

Silver seolleongtang contains somen, shiitake mushrooms, jujube, crucian carp, and brisket, and the soup is deep but not heavy and light. The chewiness of the pork belly and the firmness of the brisket go well with the soup.
The Korean beef snow noodle soup has a lot of middle noodles, so the noodles have a strong presence, and there is also a generous amount of brisket, making the bowl feel full.

All soups come lightly seasoned, so I recommend trying a spoonful first.
If you are looking for a clean lunch restaurant in Bukchon, you will be satisfied with Eunseolseollongtang.

reviews.text: It was such a strange experience. This is clearly Korea, and the restaurant was quite large and full of customers, but my husband and I were the only two Koreans. Everyone was a tourist.

I ordered the premium dish specifically because of the eel garnish shown in the menu photo — a generous long shaving on top of the chicken soup. What I actually received was a tiny, pitiful piece that looked nothing like the advertised image. When I questioned the chef, his excuses were laughable: “It’s expensive so we give less” and “The picture is just unrealistic.”

But that’s exactly the point — the dish is already more expensive on the menu, and I willingly paid for it. Customers should get what they are promised, not a watered-down version that looks like a bait-and-switch. The gap between the menu photo and reality was simply too big to ignore.

This place feels like a tourist trap — overpriced, underdelivering, and dismissive when you raise concerns. If you care about honesty and value for money, avoid it.

I saw the eel topping on the menu photo and ordered Baeknyeon Samgyetang, which was more expensive than the local samgyetang. This is because, judging from the photo, there was a large and generously placed long piece of eel. However, the actual food I received was completely different from the advertised photo, with only one small and shabby piece. When I asked the chef, I only got absurd excuses. “It’s expensive, so I’ll give you only a little”, “It’s unrealistic if it looks like the picture.” I say so.

But that's exactly the problem. I was willing to pay because the menu price itself was already expensive, so of course I should get what I promised. Customers should get what they expected, not this deceptive, poor version. The difference between the menu photo and the actual food was impossible to ignore. I know that photos and reality are completely different. But this level is not acceptable. Really. We look at what we see and look for reasons why we think it is more expensive. So even if it's not exactly the same, shouldn't it be similar enough to feel similar?

This place just feels like a tourist rip-off — the prices are exorbitant, the food is below expectations, and any complaints you raise are ignored. If you value honesty and value for money, don't go there.

This is a restaurant that mainly serves kalguksu (noodle soup). We sell warm chicken kalguksu, cold bibim kalguksu, and perilla oil kalguksu, and we also sell fried chicken, grilled bulgogi, grilled dumplings, and steamed dumplings as side menus.

The chicken broth is not a very rich broth, but I personally liked that it had a light chicken flavor. Maybe it felt more refreshing mixed with clam broth.
The thick fried dumplings are delicious, so it's good to eat them together, and the spicy kimchi goes well with kalguksu.

reviews.author: jangwon choi
reviews.text:
It is accessible from Exit 2 or Exit 3 of Anguk Station.
Easy to find as it is in front of Jaedong Elementary School.
You can see it by going to the London Bagel Museum Bukchon branch next door.

Originally, Bukchon Sonmandu’s main branch was in Insa-dong. The Bukchon branch appears to be just a franchise store.
It opens at 10 o'clock every day and closes at 9 o'clock, but the last order is 8 o'clock.
It seems like the grandfather is in charge of the kitchen and the grandmother is in charge of serving and paying the bills.
The store is really small, so if crowded together, it could probably seat about 14 people.
It's a small place with no tables so 1-2 people can eat there.
You can also order at the kiosk at the entrance.
A system that allows you to order even if you sit down and talk to the owner.

This is a place where foreigners come and eat.
It would be good to find a place like Nopo, but it is a bit narrow, so you have to endure some inconvenience.

I ordered and ate blood cold noodles (9,000 won) and dumpling soup (9,500 won).
Is it because the dumpling soup is made by not putting steamed dumplings in broth and boiling them thoroughly?
It tastes like pouring warm broth over steamed dumplings.
The dumplings that were included also felt like cold dumplings, so they didn't taste as good.
I really like cold noodles, like cold noodles sprinkled with red pepper powder.
It feels like the noodles of naengmyeon are made by pouring cold naengmyeon broth over pre-made noodles.
I understand the situation of having to prepare in advance and respond to guests, but I am disappointed.
Bukchon Son Dumplings are good value for money, but the value for money is disappointing.

I went in because it reminded me of the Bukchon Sonmandu I ate in Myeongdong before, but I was disappointed. The fried dumplings were originally delicious, but I think it's because I don't eat fried dumplings.

reviews.author: Madame Bronze
reviews.text:
Were your expectations so high that you were disappointed?
I've been keeping an eye on this place since Jeon Hyun-moo's Dumplings came out, and I've been wanting to come here ever since I saw it featured in the satire Toganjip!

They said it opens at 11, so I went for an open run and arrived first!
At 11:19, all seats were taken out and the waiting line started.

However, it was really quiet for about 10 minutes after we arrived, but the female employee wearing glasses was so rude and unfriendly that we couldn't help but wonder if something bad was going on.

well? Since this is a famous restaurant, there must have been customers intentionally coming or waiting, but it was very busy so I wasn't tired, and I felt really uncomfortable while eating, wondering if there was any need to be so unfriendly to a first-time customer.
(I ate and left by 11:35, but everyone was treated with the same unkindness haha)

Well, both dumpling soup and dumplings are just plain tasty.
It's not the type of style that sticks to your mouth.
Even though I ate a lot, I felt like I would feel comfortable all afternoon.

I ordered spicy dumpling soup, but it had some kalguksu noodles in it, which was very nice.
When the satirist said that it didn't feel like Yukgaejang, Gungmul, and dumpling soup, but that it felt like Spicy Spicy Spicy Dumpling Soup, it really hit home what he meant, and I nodded in agreement with the decision to withhold the final decision, haha.

Everyone's reviews of kimchi dumplings are negative, and I think I understand why.

Anyway, you shouldn't expect dumplings that stick to your mouth. The kimchi was geotjeori style and the radish and onion pickles were great to eat with it.

Are kimchi dumplings also elephant dumplings? •_•

reviews.text:
This is my favorite kalguksu of my life with soft noodles and non-irritating broth.
It's already been about 20 years since I've been here, but the taste is still good.
I recommend ordering an assorted pancake and a bowl of kalguksu!!

reviews.author: Jammin who loves Lee Seo dives
reviews.text:
The kalguksu pumpkin pancake here was so delicious. Pumpkin pancake is the best when it snows and rains! Kalguksu is a delicacy of all seasons and is recommended.
Yes, open on Saturday until 9pm.
They say they are closed on Sundays ^^♡♡♡

reviews.author: pro walker
reviews.text:
It's hard to eat old pumpkin pancakes in other places, but it was nice to be able to eat them and they were delicious. The assorted pancakes included pumpkin pancakes, kimchi pancakes, dongtae pancakes, and mushroom pancakes, and dongtae pancakes were the biggest part.
The noodle soup was soft and the beef bone broth was clean and seemed a little strong. I enjoyed eating the kalguksu wrapped in chive kimchi and cabbage kimchi. The owner was also very kind.
The restaurant was a bit old and not very sophisticated, but I enjoyed my meal comfortably.

reviews.author: Hyunjeong Choi
reviews.text:
After eating a bowl of warm kalguksu in the chilly fall weather, the cozy and cozy interior of the store warms my heart and makes me want to come again.
Homemade kimchi, soup, noodles... everything is in perfect harmony...
It was nice to be able to take off my shoes and sit comfortably at a restaurant for the first time in a while.

display_name: [ 🍜新羅製麺🍜 ] Anguk Station Restaurant Silla Jemyeon Anguk Branch
address: 1st floor, 19-6 Gyedong-gil, Jongno-gu, Seoul, South Korea

reviews.author: Jihyun Lee
reviews.text:
The octopus kalguksu was delicious and the potato pancake that neutralized the spiciness was also good. The staff were also friendly and nice.
Perhaps because the weather was cloudy and a bit chilly, I went at 12 o'clock, and the wait wasn't long, which was nice.

reviews.author: Hyoshin “Choi Hyo-shin” Choi
reviews.text:
I waited at 11:26 for Saturday lunch and got in about 2 hours later. Table reservations are available, so it's a good idea to make a reservation before leaving.
I was surprised to see that the proportion of customers was about half Korean and half foreigners. The octopus kalguksu was delicious, but I wonder if it would be worth waiting for two hours. I am willing to go again if there is a 30-minute wait. Dongjuk kalguksu seems to be delicious, but the wait is just too much..🙃
I ordered the regular octopus kalguksu, but since it was spicy, the regular flavor was also very spicy. It didn't seem like a lot, but the bibimbap was so substantial that I almost burst after eating it all👍🏻

reviews.author: Im Sang-hyeon
reviews.text: It goes well and is delicious when eaten together with kalguksu (noodle soup) and seafood and green onion pancakes, which are great to eat hot during the cold winter. ^^ Recommended as a date spot for a weekend outing ♡

reviews.author: Jane
reviews.text: The noodles are a bit spicy. Recommended if you like spicy food! Potato pancakes are sliced ​​potato pancakes, so they are a slightly different style than regular potato pancakes. Bibimbap is okay, so I think it would be good to eat it with something spicy.

reviews.author: J A Park
reviews.text: The wait was about an hour and a half, and I had high expectations, so it was a bit spicier than I expected, which was disappointing, but I still think the taste reminded me of addictive seasonings. And I'm someone who usually eats buldak, but even the regular flavor is really spicy... If you have a weak stomach and can't eat spicy food, this is the main menu item for you. The other menu items also looked delicious! Like other reviews, it feels like half of them are foreigners. It's spicy. I'm worried about how they enjoyed it, and since there are a lot of tourists, the standard waiting time is 1 hour even for weekday lunch.

reviews.author: kang kang
reviews.text:
A dumpling restaurant in Bukchon, Anguk Station of the Seoul subway, where a catch table is a must as the wait is long. ‘Kkangtongmandu’, a Wednesday gourmet restaurant located deep in Bukchok alley, closes early due to running out of ingredients before break time! Even if you try to wait after arriving at the site, I've seen many people run out of ingredients and run out of ingredients. The wisest choice is to use the 'Catch Table app' 20 to 30 minutes before arrival! It seemed like really good quality food for this price. It was very delicious and many people agreed so there always seems to be a long line.
How can bibim noodles cost 12,000?!

However, canned dumplings can do just that. The thick Korean beef meat bibim noodles with fragrant perilla seed powder had a firm texture, making it the most luxurious bibim noodle I've ever tasted.

reviews.author: Mazinger K
reviews.text:
This is a famous dumpling restaurant with 40 years of tradition. It features smooth and light Pyongyang-style dumplings and chewy dumpling skin, and there is always a long wait.

Business hours
Weekdays: 11:30~21:00
Saturday: 11:30~20:00
Break time: 15:30~17:00
Closed on Sundays

It is so popular that there is a wait of over 1 hour on weekdays and 2 hours on weekends. It is recommended to wait while waiting using catch tables, etc.

reviews.author: Eatttsiyeon
reviews.text:
Delicious!!! I waited for about 30 minutes to go in, but the owner was nice and it was nice to be able to eat really warm food.
The dumplings are also filling with squid and shrimp. It's been a while since I've seen a place in Seoul that serves side dishes like this.

reviews.author: a k
reviews.text:
I went after 1 o'clock on a weekday, and there were about 7 teams waiting. When I was waiting, I also placed an order. Kalmandu and bibim noodles!
The bibim kalguksu topped with shredded meat was good because the sauce wasn't spicy and had lots of toppings. The noodles absorbed the seasoning so it was sweet and not spicy. Beef bone broth kalguksu had a deep flavor and the tofu was filled with green onions.

reviews.author: Dj_msk
reviews.text:
The neat and clean taste of Seoul. It’s a taste without any unnecessary elements. The ingredients are fresh and seasoned appropriately as expected from Seoul food.
What's a little disappointing is that you can order at the catch table before entering and you can't place additional orders after entering.

reviews.author: Philosophizing
reviews.text:
You can taste delicious spicy noodles and chicken skewers at the same time.
The location is great as it is a small country, and the service attitude is also good....
This is a place I recommend visiting.

reviews.author: gluttonous detective
reviews.text: This is a place I stopped by to eat during lunch time because I missed the meal time. Since it is a franchise with so many stores, I had reasonable expectations when I visited, but I was very disappointed. The bibim noodles I ate had a strange spice taste, so it was a bit difficult to eat. If there had been a bit more detailed explanation, I would have tried a different menu.

reviews.author: HYUNYONG HWANG
reviews.text:
The warm skewered noodles are delicious!!! But it’s expensive!!!
Proof that noodles are not some noodles
After my return visit, I will add a photo of the skewered noodles and whole noodles.

reviews.author: hiedung heedoong
reviews.text:
First review:
I was hungry so I went into a house by chance with a friend...
The whole noodle soup..... It's a work of art!! I ate there without knowing it was a good restaurant, but I definitely want to go back and try it!!
ㅡㅡㅡㅡㅡㅡㅡㅡㅡㅡㅡㅡㅡㅡㅡㅡㅡ
Second review:
I kept thinking about the chewy texture of the noodles and the spicy broth, so I did it again yesterday!! I went there with my friend.
As expected.. the soup is so refreshing that I think I will remember it even in the cold winter!!
The highball is good, and the raw Daelim beer is super refreshing and delicious!!
There are many different types of skewers, but the bank skewers always come to mind haha.
ㅡㅡㅡㅡㅡㅡㅡㅡㅡㅡㅡㅡㅡㅡㅡㅡ
Third review:
On a hot day, it doesn't suit me well.
Next time, I’m going to try it with bibim.
My friend who took me ate it all in one go.

reviews.author: Kook-Hyun Kim
reviews.text:
I ate it with whole noodles, but you can think of it as meat noodles.
Because the broth is made from boiled meat, it slides smoothly in your mouth. There is quite a bit of meat in the noodles, and the noodles are thicker and stickier than 10,000 somen noodles.
These are delicious noodles.

address: 73-1 Basement 1, Seoul, Republic of Korea KR Gyedong-gil, Jongno-gu, Seoul

reviews.author: Jieun Kang
reviews.text: [Kor/Eng] This restaurant has the cleanest, most generous, and delicious Thai food I've ever been to. 😋 So far, I've tried Pad Thai, Pu Pad Pong Curry, and Pad Seeyu. It's even better because you can add chicken, shrimp, etc. It's a restaurant I think will be good to run for a long time! Best taste, seasoning, freshness of ingredients ever among Thai restaurants i've ever been so far 😋 i like that i can order extra shrimps, chickens and others too. This is a restaurant that i wish to come for a long time :)

reviews.author: Seungyeon Kim
reviews.text:
It's so delicious....🥹
Since it's underground, I'm slightly concerned about ventilation, but...
It seemed like they made Thai food to suit Korean tastes haha.
It's not the taste of mainland Thailand, but I think you'll enjoy trying Thai food.. I don't think there will be much difference in likes and dislikes!!!!👍
It was nice to be able to have as much sriracha sauce as I wanted. Goes perfectly with fried rice⭐️

reviews.author: Origin
reviews.text: Pad Thai and fried rice are generally delicious. The atmosphere is nice and the menu is diverse. The hall is small, so it may be difficult for many people. It's good for dating. Willing to visit again

reviews.author: VV JIN14
reviews.text:
Make a reservation in advance for lunch and visit!
Tom Yum Goong is delicious and Pad Thai and fried rice are both good.
Although it's underground
The atmosphere of the store is trendy and nice 🥰

reviews.author: sehyeon hwang
reviews.text:
This was my first time trying Thai food and I felt fortunate to have it here!!! It's so delicious ㅠㅠ

At first, I ordered spring rolls and pad thai.
I can't believe it... It's the first time I've encountered an exotic food that's easy to overlook. I'm really crazy about shrimp.

I will definitely add shrimp next time.

This is my first time eating Pupatppong curry. Haha... I kept smiling while eating... I was going crazy...

+ The Thai milk tea was crazy.. The portion size seems small, but I would still order it again! I drank it with that thought in mind.

+ You must order the Pupatppong curry rice separately!

+ The bathroom is on the first floor, but the stairs up are slightly high. Still, the bathroom is really, really clean and nice!

reviews.author: Renee
reviews.text:
I took a walk around Gyeongbokgung Palace with my family today. I was hungry in the afternoon, so I originally planned to go to Cheongsujeong and eat Korean food, but the line was so long that I couldn't wait, so I walked and found a small restaurant called 'Small Happiness'. I ordered bibimbap for 11,000 won, cold cold noodles for 11,000 won, and iron plate tteokgalbi for 14,000 won.

My bibimbap was really delicious. I was very satisfied with the perfect combination of fresh ingredients and spicy sauce. My friend also ordered Chemchujang, and he said the teppanyaki tteokgalbi was really delicious!

The interior isn't particularly flashy and looks like a typical small shop, but the food was delicious and the staff were very friendly, making it a quite satisfying dining experience!

reviews.author: LittleVictor & Daddy (vOonY)
reviews.text: It's a good Korean restaurant in a small alley. I ordered three dishes today and they were all really delicious. Fried pork, grilled minced pork, squid rice bowl, and kimchi were served as side dishes.

reviews.author: SY Sun
reviews.text:
Food is a bit expensive. Some of the menu items are good, but overall it's so-so. Overall, it's average.
==============Details===========
🥢🥢Meal🥢🥢
📍Spicy stir-fried octopus (rice included) $12,000
Review: 🌟🌟🌟🌟
This dish is pretty good. The vegetables help keep the rice sticky, and the sauce is not just spicy, but closer to fermented soybean paste with an unknown aroma. 😀
The octopus legs are generous but the portion is small.

📍Steamed ribs $14,000
Rating: 🌟🌟
This dish was really disappointing. 🥲
I liked the burger patty as it was quite juicy. There were also some unique spices, which were quite unique. Unfortunately, the biggest problem was that the mince wasn't cooked enough. The patty was so thin that when I bit into it, I could smell the meat. Personally, I didn't like the texture.

📍Naengmyeon $11,000
Rating: 🌟🌟🌟
I forgot what kind of cold noodles I ordered. 🤣
Please cut the noodles before eating! ️
The sauce is similar to rice, but it doesn't mix well, perhaps because of the broth.

📍Side dish $0
Rating: 🌟🌟🌟
The food is really great, the cold salads are refreshing and delicious. However, it is a pity that the amount is a bit small.

💁💁Service💁💁
It was nice that the staff didn't rush us even though the place was full. He spoke a little Chinese, and I remember him explaining the food very patiently.

🛖🛖Atmosphere🛖🛖
The restaurant is small and not spacious, but has a very cozy atmosphere. The atmosphere is comfortable for dining.

reviews.author: Sian Anna
reviews.text: There is a minimum order amount and you must order one menu item per person. The bibimbap was quite delicious, slightly spicy and the ingredients were fresh. The portion of pork cutlet was generous and came with soup and side dishes. There is also a restroom.

reviews.author: Brandt Bacha
reviews.text: It was the cleanest food I had in Korea. Every dish was special and the portions were just right. If the restaurant is full, be sure to wait in line. It's worth the wait.

reviews.author: Howard C
reviews.text:
The food was delicious, but I am writing this because there was a problem with the overall service.

1. Mosquito repellent smell in the store
It was summer and the indoor air conditioner was turned on, so I lit a mosquito repellent. ? At a restaurant? In a confined space? A smell that is strong enough to overpower the smell of food is also a problem... but if there are mosquitoes, you have to quarantine them. I don't know why you kill mosquitoes and customers at the same time.

2. Molten Bowl
It's nice that you confidently say that you used a torch to infuse the rice noodles. If that's the case, I think you should have used a different bowl. I wonder if they knew what kind of chemicals would come out of the plastic bowl that melts when burned, so they let us eat it.

Just thinking about the food... yes, it tastes good, but I don't want to visit a restaurant with this kind of management again.

reviews.author: Doyoung Kim
reviews.text:
It's my first time trying spicy rice noodles, but it's a taste that everyone will like, no matter who likes or dislikes it! If you ask for cilantro, they give you a lot of it, and the basic amount of all dishes is large!!
It’s so delicious~

reviews.author: Yongsuk Sung
reviews.text: The taste, quantity, and price of the signature dish, rice noodles, are all excellent. The thick and spicy(?) soup, which seems to be based on bone broth, and the strong meat topping seem to have all been localized, and it seems to have been very successful, perhaps because of the good ingredients. Cilantro was provided upon separate request and was very fresh so it was nice to enjoy the flavor.

reviews.author: Seongho Yoo
reviews.text: A Vietnamese restaurant located in Insa-dong. The amount of rice noodles full of spicy flavor is enormous, so when two people come, most people order rice noodles + one dish. When you mix Viet beer and Dung Guit lotus, the aromas and aromas combine to create a new liquor with an exotic flavor.

reviews.author: Walk around the neighborhood
reviews.text: This restaurant is very satisfying with its atmosphere, taste, and value for money. I happened to stop by while passing by and found out that it was a good restaurant. The portions were plentiful and very delicious. I had banh xeo and rice noodles, and there was a wait as the store wasn't that big, but it was worth the wait. (Parking lot x) Highly recommended.
